description: This file defines a REST exception handler for a Java Spring application. It maps different internal exceptions to appropriate HTTP error responses using Spring's @RestControllerAdvice and @ExceptionHandler annotations.

classes.name: ApiExceptionHandler
classes.description: A REST controller advice class that handles specific exceptions and maps them to HTTP responses with detailed problem information.

methods.name: handleNotFound
methods.description: Handles NoSuchElementException by returning a 404 Not Found with details.

methods.name: handleBadRequest
methods.description: Handles IllegalArgumentException by returning a 400 Bad Request with details.

methods.name: handleErrorResponse
methods.description: Handles ErrorResponseException by returning its embedded body as the response.

methods.name: handleGeneric
methods.description: Handles any unspecified exceptions by returning a 500 Internal Server Error.
